description: Load model files into a session, as %load does: files, directories or globs, resolved against the workspace root and refused outside it. Every file is accepted before the model is analyzed, so load order does not matter, and files beside the paths that declare a namespace they import load too. Returns what loaded and the diagnostics.

paths.description: files, directories (walked for .sysml/.kerml/.ipynb) or glob patterns, relative to the workspace root or absolute; a path outside the root is refused

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

name: session_load

declared.description: what the load declared, as the prompt summarizes it; empty when the analysis found an error

diagnostics.description: every finding over the session's model after the load, located in its file

file.description: the loaded file the finding is in; empty for text submitted directly

line.description: 1-based line within the file or submission

pass.description: the analysis pass that produced the finding

errors.description: whether the session's model now has an error

files.description: the model files the paths named, in load order; files they import from beside them load too
